example.title: Christian Kupke farmstead (Farm at Long Lane), crib barn

brief: Drive-through corn crib and implement barn about 26 ft wide and 34 ft deep: a tall gable front with a dark open driveway in the center, flanking crib walls of horizontal boards with peeling white paint over grey wood, a large white-boarded loft door above, and a small square gabled cupola with a louvered side on the ridge. Silver corrugated metal roof, white-painted concrete foundation. Sits at the bend of a grassy farm lane with spruce and cedar windbreaks behind and soybean fields around.
